notes.title: Mini Patch Update: Easier Minigames 🎮
notes.content:
Thank you so much for playing TOY BOX! We communicated with our minigame coder to lower the difficulty of the "investigation" sequences. These changes will also increase clarity for certain assets.

- Enpointe: Crown section is now easier to complete. The crown is now outlined with slower movement.
- Tune-Me-Toe: Final section now has a larger responsive area.

notes.title: [ FEB UPDATE ] Skip Minigame Button, QOL Changes
notes.content:
Thank you for your feedback on TOY BOX! Below are all bug fixes in the newest patch:

    [olist]
[*] Interruption timer is now lowered to three minutes.
[*]     Splash screen added.
[*]     A new toggle option that allows the player to skip all minigames.
[*]     We are in the process of fixing minigames, but we hope that this update allows players to be able to solely enjoy the narrative of the game!
[/olist]
As more feedback comes to us, we'll be updating this list with additional fixes.

notes.title: I can't bear to play much of free horror game Toy Box, but I love the concept of pulling talking toys apart
notes.content:
Toy Box sounds like a very Xmassy game, but then you watch a trailer, and realise that it is not very Xmassy at all. It's a free visual novel with a macabre puzzling element. The setup is that you're a toy inspector working for a jovial Grand Toy Maker, his face hidden above the top of the screen. Your job is to disassemble toys - five in all - according to his eldritch written instructions, and either "salvage" them or "sentence" them to the incinerator.

notes.title: TOY BOX IS NOW RELEASED!
notes.content:
We are exhilarated to announce that TOY BOX is now out on [url=https://deadline-co.itch.io/fools-paradise]Itch.io[/url]! Our team at DEADline Studios sincerely thanks everyone involved in the project for helping bring it to life! In addition, an ending walkthrough will be posted in a few days. 

In the meantime, we will look into fixing bugs and translating the game into Spanish. If you have any questions, feel free to comment on the game, send an ask to our [url=https://deadvnstudios.tumblr.com/]Tumblr[/url], or join DEADline Studio’s [url=https://discord.gg/dcWWznnhTt]Discord[/url] for direct support!

Before playing, remember that some topics featured in the game are triggering to some. Please check the warnings on the game’s main Itch.io page. We hope you have a spooky experience!

- DEADline Studios Team
